people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: The people said to Joshua, “No, but we will serve Yahweh.”
translations.bsb: “No!” replied the people. “We will serve the LORD!”
translations.kjv: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD.
translations.asv: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve Jehovah.
